entities.name: Václav Klement
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Václav Klement was a Czech entrepreneur, industrialist and automotive pioneer. He, along with Václav Laurin, founded automobile manufacturer Laurin & Klement that later became Škoda Auto, the largest Czech company.
